abilities.name: Caduceus Reactor
abilities.description: While channeling Healing Beam, Lt. Morales regenerates 2% of her maximum Health per second.; trait

fields.notes: Lt. Morales uses Energy instead of Mana as a resource. Morales has 100 max Energy, which regenerates at 6 Energy per second while not using Healing Beam.

abilities.name: Healing Beam
abilities.description: Heal target ally for 172 Health per second as long as they are in range. After not channeling Healing Beam for 2 seconds, regenerate 6 Energy per second. Reactivate to switch targets. Self-cast or activate your Trait to cancel the channel.

fields.notes: Consumes no energy, but still triggers Caduceus Reactor , when held on a full Health target. Healing Beam goes on cooldown for 2 seconds when interrupted by enemies, 0.5 seconds when switching target, 0.5 seconds when canceling it within 0.5 seconds from the beginning of the channel, and 0 seconds when canceling it after 0.5 seconds from the beginning of the channel. Lt. Morales can attack and use her Abilities without interrupting Healing Beam. Consumes 3 Energy per Healing tick while activated. Healing Beam is able to heal Minions.

abilities.name: Redirect Healing Beam
abilities.description: Redirect Healing Beam to another target. Use on self to cancel channeling.

abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.description: Grant target ally Hero 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects except Garrosh's Trait. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack

abilities.name: Displacement Grenade
abilities.description: Fire a grenade that can be manually detonated, dealing 208 damage to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

fields.val4: Detonate Displacement Grenade - Detonate Displacement Grenade, dealing 208 damage to nearby enemies and knocking them away.
fields.notes: Grenade detonates automatically at maximum range.

abilities.name: Stim Drone
abilities.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.; 70; heroic

fields.props: Attack Speed buff, Channeled cast (stationary), Movement Speed buff
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Cast is interrupted if the target moves over 10 range beyond the Ability's maximum range before the channel has finished.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship
abilities.description: Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac. Medivac Dropship ; 45; heroic

fields.range: - Min: 11 - Max: 100 Selecting Medivac Dropship also unlocks Reinforcements Ability, which shares a cooldown with it. Interrupting the Ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Must be cast on pathable surface. Lt. Morales is automatically put in the dropship once the cast finishes. Allies that enter Dropship cannot leave manually. All Heroes inside are ejected automatically when Dropship reaches its destination or is destroyed. Upon successfully casting Medivac Dropship, Lt. Morales gains access to Depart Ability, which can be cast after 3 seconds to immediately launch toward the target location. The dropship departs automatically after 10 seconds. Heroes that have entered the dropship cannot leave until it arrives to its target location. Heroes inside the dropship are put in Stasis, removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles) and have no collision. Enemies can attack the dropship. If the dropship is destroyed, the Heroes inside it will be immediately ejected and Stunned for 0.5 seconds.
fields.notes: Dropship is Unstoppable and has no collision.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship - Depart
abilities.description: Departs for the target location immediately.; 0.5; heroic

fields.notes: Starts on a 3 second cooldown upon successfully casting Medivac Dropship or Reinforcements.

abilities.name: Medivac Dropship - Reinforcements
abilities.description: Call down a Medivac Dropship at your Hall of Storms for your allies. After 10 seconds, or when the Ability is activated again, the Medivac will travel to its original cast location to unload its passengers.; 45 / 3.0; heroic

fields.notes: Shares cooldown with Medivac Dropship. Can be recast after 3 seconds to depart immediately. Cannot be cast while within the mines on Haunted Mines.

talents.name: Medi-Drone
talents.description: Allies with Safeguard receive 75% of the healing done by Healing Beam on another ally.

fields.notes: Medi-Drone does not heal if the primary target of Healing Beam is at full Health. Lt. Morales can also benefit from Medi-Drone by using Safeguard on herself. Medi-Drone benefits from the bonus healing from First Responder. Medi-Drone has its own separate base value that is 75% of Healing Beam 's, causing the percentage to stack multiplicatively with healing modifiers and bonus healing effects.

talents.name: Bedside Manner
talents.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade will take an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage from Lt. Morales's next Basic Attack against them. Passive Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 1% of maximum Health as damage.

fields.notes: Displacement Grenade puts a mark on the enemy Hero that lasts for 6 seconds and is consumed if Lt. Morales Basic Attacks them during this time, dealing the bonus damage, or else expires at the end of this interval. The mark is removed, but the bonus damage does not connect, if Lt. Morales is Blinded or if the target is Evading on this Basic Attack.
